changelog:
Initial release of the animation skill — generate CSS/SVG animation code from the command line.

- Supports creating production-ready CSS keyframes, transitions, motion paths, and easing functions.
- Stores all animation definitions locally for reuse, chaining, sequencing, and export.
- Includes commands for building, exporting, previewing, and listing animations.
- Outputs code as JSON, raw CSS/SVG, or HTML previews.
- Runs on Python 3.6+ and Bash 4+.
summary: Generate CSS and SVG animation code snippets using bash and Python. Use when building UI animations, keyframes, or transition effects.
